summary: Learn to assess environmental issues, compare policy options and build implementation tools. Explore the five-day course and plan your training.
lede: Environmental sustainability planning and policy connects environmental evidence to objectives, policy options and review. For environmental policy officers, sustainability coordinators and planners, this course develops a practical process for turning an issue into a proposal: define the problem and indicators, assess alternatives using structured options appraisal, and plan responsibilities and monitoring.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for professionals who shape environmental priorities, draft policy proposals or coordinate their delivery. It suits you if you need a clear process for moving from an environmental issue to objectives, options, responsibilities and review measures.
prerequisites: No prior environmental policy qualification is required. Familiarity with environmental issues in your work is useful. No coding or programming is required; exercises use policy templates and basic spreadsheet functions.
